instructions: Read each work activity and decide how you would feel about doing it. Do not think about how much education or training is needed or how much money you would make.

scoring.manual_ref: IP Manual (2021), Chapter 3, Automated Scoring Systems

occupation_link.method: Pearson correlation between the person's six scores and the occupation's O*NET Interest profile (OI)

scoring.all_strongly_dislike_message: You answered "strongly dislike" to all questions. Your results may not reflect your interests. Please consider retaking the Interest Profiler at a different time.

item_order_note: Items keep the official Short Form wording. Order: two items per area in the sequence R, I, A, S, E, C, repeated five times, following the item sequence of the official form.
